blocks.text: This part of the chapter explores the role of chemistry in modern agriculture. It discusses the importance of fertilisers, pesticides and genetic engineering in increasing the food supply for a growing world population. It also describes the chemical reactions of acid rain on crops and soil and explains how climate change affects crop growth.

blocks.prompt: Name three ways chemistry helps increase food supply.
blocks.explanation: Fertilisers, pesticides and genetic engineering of crops.

items: Agriculture: fertilisers, pesticides, genetic engineering, acid rain, climate change.
